_comment: Fitted forgiveness law: ratio = coefficient * raw_edge_error^exponent. Replaces the two-point Cairo constants of Entries 017/019, whose high-error anchor edge (19,22) failed the Entry 021 decoherence screen (T2 = 6.9 us, D = 0.31).

edges_rejected.reason: T2 = 12.7 us; decay dominated by dephasing, ratio physically impossible

superseded.reason: Two points define a power law exactly, so the fit had zero residual and could not be tested. The high-error anchor (19,22) was later found to be decoherence-dominated.

known_limitation: Entry 020 established that absolute forgiveness constants are chip-specific (Sherbrooke ran ~26% above Cairo). This law is therefore an interim single-chip default, not a universal constant. Per-chip calibration via the six-edge D-screened protocol is the intended replacement.
